title: cardamine leucantha f. koreana
intro: Cardamine leucantha f. koreana, commonly known as Korean Bitter Cress, is a flowering plant in the mustard family (Brassicaceae). It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cardamine leucantha f. koreana include treating fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. Its bioactive constituents include isothiocyanates, which have been shown to exhibit potential anti-cancer and anti-viral effects.
